subject: One traveler in a burnt-orange jacket walks a sea-green touring bicycle along a coastal path toward a white lighthouse.
anchors: dark headland between two sea fields
relationships: the traveler and bicycle follow the path toward the lighthouse destination
the lighthouse remains small but visually aligned with the route
visual_path: a dark S-shaped path begins behind the traveler and rises across the headland to the lighthouse
metaphor: the coastal path becomes a compass needle connecting the traveler to a distant beacon
transform: single warm break in the clouds
